material_proof: A selected current-source run records the Food and Storage zones plus supplied food only as setup; then retains accepted native receipts for food distribution, the camp board, selecting a current available worker, a three-hour companion-mission departure, native elapsed time, matching recovery selection, and return.  Post-action observations show changed food supply and the returned worker's state, and the run has accepted cleanup.
